title: DPN transportability analysis: code and frozen reproducibility archive

description: Frozen analysis code, environment specification, sample metadata, selected processed derivatives, numerical result tables, figures, and traceability audits for a source-frozen, non-pooled study of human sensory-ganglion transcriptomic-program transportability in diabetic neuropathy. Third-party raw data are not redistributed.
